parameters.query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rigs WHERE visible=1) as totalRigs, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM failures WHERE isRemoved=0 AND status!='closed') as openFailures, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM failures WHERE isRemoved=0 AND severity='critical' AND status!='closed') as criticalFailures, (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(CAST(nptHours AS FLOAT)),0) FROM nonProductionTimes WHERE isRemoved=0 AND dateOfNPT >= DATEADD(DAY,-1,GETDATE())) as nptHoursYesterday, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM certificateAttachments WHERE expiryDate >= GETDATE() AND expiryDate <= DATEADD(DAY,30,GETDATE())) as certsExpiring30d, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM deferredMaintenanceTasks WHERE isRemoved=0) as deferredTasks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM observations WHERE isRemoved=0 AND status='open') as openObservations, (SELECT ISNULL(AVG(availability),0) FROM KPI WHERE createdAt >= DATEADD(MONTH,-1,GETDATE())) as avgAvailability

parameters.name: question
parameters.value: =Generate a concise executive summary for today based on these fleet metrics: {{ JSON.stringify($node['Query Fleet Metrics'].json) }}. Highlight key risks, any critical failures, high NPT, and top 3 recommended actions for management attention.

parameters.query: SELECT TOP 5 r.name as rigName, COUNT(f.id) as failureCount, ISNULL(SUM(CAST(n.nptHours AS FLOAT)),0) as nptHours FROM rigs r LEFT JOIN failures f ON f.rigId=r.id AND f.isRemoved=0 AND f.createdAt >= DATEADD(DAY,-1,GETDATE()) LEFT JOIN nonProductionTimes n ON n.rigId=r.id AND n.isRemoved=0 AND n.dateOfNPT >= DATEADD(DAY,-1,GETDATE()) WHERE r.visible=1 GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY failureCount DESC, nptHours DESC
